تستكشفون (form X)
# تَسْتَكْشِفُونَ (tastakšifūna) /tas.tak.ʃi.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# تُسْتَكْشَفُونَ (tustakšafūna) /tus.tak.ʃa.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
